attempts.summary: Created a persistent LVM logical volume (srv_data_vg/data_lv) mounted at /srv/data on node1, backed by two loop-device PVs since the node's single disk had no free space. Initial LV was 1000M; extended live to <2.15 GiB (2.1G filesystem) while mounted, with test data preserved throughout. Set up a systemd oneshot service (srv-data-loop.service) to reattach the loop devices and activate the VG at boot, and an /etc/fstab entry so /srv/data auto-mounts. Verified persistence by rebooting node1: boot_id changed, and post-reboot the LV was auto-activated, /srv/data auto-mounted at the grown 2.1G size, and the test file's SHA256 checksum matched pre-reboot.
